proposals.before: In the tenth month of the third year of Tianfu, Jin envoys led by commissioner Li Wanquan came with tribute. Wanquan was appointed Great General of Returning Allegiance and overseer Lei Fude Compliant Transformation General.
proposals.after: In the tenth month of the third year of Tianfu of Jin they sent commissioner Li Wanquan and others to court with tribute; Wanquan was made Great General of Returning Allegiance and overseer Lei Fude Compliant Transformation General.
proposals.reason: Chinese subject is the Uyghur mission (遣使都督李萬全等朝貢), not Jin envoys; the idiomatic English invents Jin as the sender.

decisions.reason: 晉天福三年十月 is Jin-era dating, not the sender; 遣使都督李萬全等朝貢 continues the Huihu tribute subject from the preceding units. The before wrongly calls them Jin envoys; the proposed after correctly has they (the Uyghurs) send Li Wanquan and others.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 遣使都督李萬全等朝貢
